ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Phillips Collection members will receive a discounted tuition rate of $450. Due to this course's advanced nature, you must receive pre-approval before registering. Please contact Jessica Cash for approval (217-333-2537, jcash@uiuc.edu). Graduate studnets must register for 4 credit hours and undergrads for 3 credit hours. Classes will be held at the Phillips Collection museum in the Carriage House Conference Room.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
